SELECT FROM communities
status = 'ACTIVE'
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT c.name, COUNT(cm.member_id) AS member_count FROM communities c LEFT JOIN community_members cm ON c.community_id = cm.community_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.community_id, c.name ORDER BY member_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
